status_count.map: function(doc) { if(doc.type==='task' && doc.project_id && doc.administrative_level_id) { emit([doc.project_id, doc.administrative_level_id], { total:1, completed: doc.completed?1:0, invalid: doc.validated===false?1:0, invalid_revised: (doc.validated===false && doc.updated_after_invalidation===true)?1:0 }); } }
status_count.reduce: function(keys, values, rereduce) { var result={total:0, completed:0, invalid:0, invalid_revised:0}; values.forEach(function(v){ result.total += v.total; result.completed += v.completed; result.invalid += v.invalid; result.invalid_revised += v.invalid_revised; }); return result; }

status_count_full.map: function(doc) { if(doc.type==='task' && doc.project_id && doc.administrative_level_id) { var base = { total:1, completed: doc.completed?1:0, invalid: doc.validated===false?1:0, invalid_revised: (doc.validated===false && doc.updated_after_invalidation===true)?1:0 }; emit([doc.project_id, doc.administrative_level_id], base); if(doc.phase_id) { emit([doc.project_id, doc.administrative_level_id,'phase',doc.phase_id], base); } if(doc.activity_id) { emit([doc.project_id, doc.administrative_level_id,'activity',doc.activity_id], base); } } }
status_count_full.reduce: function(keys, values, rereduce) { var result={total:0, completed:0, invalid:0, invalid_revised:0}; values.forEach(function(v){ result.total += v.total; result.completed += v.completed; result.invalid += v.invalid; result.invalid_revised += v.invalid_revised; }); return result; }

status_count_by_phase_activity.map: function(doc) { if(doc.type==='task' && doc.project_id && doc.phase_id && doc.activity_id) { emit([doc.project_id, doc.phase_id, doc.activity_id], { total:1, completed: doc.completed?1:0, invalid: doc.validated===false?1:0, invalid_revised: (doc.validated===false && doc.updated_after_invalidation===true)?1:0 }); } }
status_count_by_phase_activity.reduce: function(keys, values, rereduce) { var result={total:0, completed:0, invalid:0, invalid_revised:0}; values.forEach(function(v){ result.total += v.total; result.completed += v.completed; result.invalid += v.invalid; result.invalid_revised += v.invalid_revised; }); return result; }
